title: Make Kafoo say when it has nothing
objective: The relevance judgement that replaces a score threshold, because measurement established that no threshold works.
acceptance_criteria: judge-results cannot reorder, filter, add or remove a Meal, and may only name Meals it was given
golden cases cover: results plainly answer; nothing answers; RESULTS TOPICALLY CLOSE BUT WRONG; a request inviting a popularity claim; one inviting a proximity claim; adversarial text in the request
the topically-close-but-wrong case passes — if the judgement only catches obviously unrelated results it has bought nothing a score already failed to do
a failed, slow or malformed judgement leaves results exactly as they are
judge-results holds no service-role key and writes nothing (FR-018, T217)
SC-004 verified by name — 100%, and it does not degrade with corpus size
notes: This exists because both candidate thresholds measured BACKWARDS — a query the corpus cannot answer scored higher than one answered correctly. Within a corpus that is entirely food, every food query is topically similar to everything, and a better model does not fix that. The E2 finding applies directly: replaying meal-description against a real model caught it stating things the Cook never said while three golden cases marked all of it PASS. The same failure here names food nobody is cooking.
